name: shared-code-editor
description: SynCode - Real-Time Collaborative Code Editor with AI Review & Multi-Language Execution

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
